registration.welcome: {wave} Welcome to the clan! {phone} How to register: 1. Open Clash Royale → your profile (player icon) 2. Tap the tag under your name (example in the photo: #YG9JVJY2) 3. Choose “Copy Tag” 4. Send the copied tag here in this chat {pin} Tag example: #9YJ8P2L (always starts with #) {loop} If you have several accounts in the clan, register all of them, but register your main one first. It will be your name in the group. {check} Once you're registered, you'll get a link to the clan's Telegram group.

unregister.usage:
Remove a player's registration:
/unregister #TAG — by Clash Royale tag
/unregister @username — by Telegram username
/unregister 123456789 — by Telegram ID
unregister.accounts_left: The player's other accounts remain, so they stay in the group.
unregister.group_removed: 👢 Also removed from the Telegram group. After registering again with /start, they'll get a link to come back.
unregister.group_not_member: The player wasn't in the Telegram group. They can register again with /start.
unregister.group_failed: ⚠️ Couldn't remove the player from the Telegram group — do it manually or check that the bot can ban users. They can register again with /start.

admin.panel_backup: 💾 Every Thursday at the war day end time, a /data backup is sent to the first admin in LOGS_ALLOWED_TG_IDS.

time.reminder_not_before_end:
(Fri–Mon)
  ⚠️ Not before war day end — fix with /time auto
time.usage:
/time boundary H M — war day end
/time reminder H M — group reminder
/time auto — reminder 30 min before end
/time auto H M — war day end + reminder 30 min before
/time notify H — “Notify everyone” allowed H h before end
time.set_both: ✅ War day end set to {end}, group reminder to {reminder}
time.set_notify: ✅ “Notify everyone” allowed from {notify_from} ({notify_hours} h before end)
time.invalid_hours:
❌ Expected hours from 1 to 24.
Example: /time notify 12
time.invalid_value:
❌ Expected HOUR MINUTE (hour 0–23, minute 0–59).
Example: /time reminder 9 0
time.no_job_queue: ⚠️ Job queue isn't running — the reminder and backup won't be sent.
